title: andreassag/advena pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow v2.0.0 mobileome discovery, cargo profiling, and comparative genomics pipeline for Bacillota ICEs and IMEs

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated samplesheet CSV containing sample IDs and GenBank and/or FASTA paths.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

icescreen_options.title: ICEscreen options
icescreen_options.description: Parameters for the core ICEscreen detection workflow.

db_url.description: URL or path to the ICEscreen database archive (.tar.gz).

db_dir.description: Path to a directory containing a pre-extracted ICEscreen database, or where the downloaded database should be cached.

blast_options.title: BLAST options
blast_options.description: Parameters for BLASTP signature protein searches.

blastp_max_target_seqs.description: Maximum number of target sequences per BLASTP query.

module_toggle_options.title: Optional analysis module toggles
module_toggle_options.description: Enable optional QC, mobile cargo profiling, complementary MGE context, and cohort comparative genomics stages.

run_all.description: Convenience preset enabling all optional analysis stages (QC, taxonomy, AMR/CARD, eggNOG, DefenseFinder, BGC, MGE context, att sites, cohort clustering, MultiQC, and synteny).

run_qc.description: Run QUAST and CheckM2 assembly quality and completeness checks.

run_taxonomy_check.description: Run GTDB-Tk taxonomic classification to verify Bacillota phylum assignment.

run_amr.description: Run AMRFinderPlus (--plus) and CARD RGI with native locus/coordinate dereplication (DEREP_AMR_CARD).

run_eggnog.description: Run eggNOG-mapper (DIAMOND mode) and extract hierarchical Bacteria/Bacillota OGs and COG categories.

run_defense.description: Run DefenseFinder (MacSyFinder + CasFinder models) for anti-phage defense and toxin-antitoxin systems.

run_bgc.description: Run antiSMASH-lite on annotated GenBank genomes and intersect secondary metabolite BGCs with ICE/IME intervals.

run_mge_context.description: Run MOB-suite recon, geNomad, ISEScan, and IntegronFinder to disambiguate plasmids, prophages, IS elements, and integrons.

run_att_sites.description: Detect attL/attR direct repeats and tRNA/housekeeping integration hotspots flanking boundary integrases.

run_cohort_cluster.description: Run cross-genome ICE/IME clustering with skani (--small-genomes) and MMseqs2.

run_multiqc.description: Generate an interactive MultiQC cohort report combining QC, ICE/IME, AMR/CARD, eggNOG COG, and MGE context panels.

run_synteny.description: Generate pyGenomeViz SVG and interactive HTML synteny alignments for clustered ICE/IME loci.

database_options.title: Database options
database_options.description: Unified cache directory and per-tool reference database paths.

db_cache_dir.description: Unified cache directory for auto-downloaded reference databases via Nextflow storeDir.

auto_download_large_dbs.description: Explicitly allow automatic download of large (>30 GB) databases (GTDB-Tk, eggNOG, Bakta full) when their --*_db path is unset.

bakta_db.description: Path to a pre-downloaded Bakta database directory.

bakta_db_type.description: Bakta database flavour when auto-downloading ('light' or 'full').

checkm2_db.description: Path to a pre-downloaded CheckM2 DIAMOND database file or directory.

gtdbtk_db.description: Path to a pre-downloaded GTDB-Tk reference data directory.

amrfinderplus_db.description: Path to a pre-downloaded AMRFinderPlus database directory.

card_db.description: Path to a pre-downloaded CARD database directory or card.json file.

eggnog_db.description: Path to a pre-downloaded eggNOG-mapper database directory.

defensefinder_db.description: Path to a pre-downloaded DefenseFinder/MacSyFinder models directory.

mobsuite_db.description: Path to a pre-downloaded MOB-suite database directory.

genomad_db.description: Path to a pre-downloaded geNomad database directory.

antismash_db.description: Path to a pre-downloaded antiSMASH database directory.

qc_and_cargo_options.title: QC, cargo, MGE context, and cohort options
qc_and_cargo_options.description: Thresholds and scope parameters for QC gating, element extraction, AMR/CARD dereplication, eggNOG, att site detection, and cohort clustering.

strict_qc.description: Exclude samples failing CheckM2 completeness/contamination thresholds from downstream ICEscreen analysis instead of warning only.

min_completeness.description: Minimum CheckM2 genome completeness percentage for QC pass.

max_contamination.description: Maximum CheckM2 genome contamination percentage for QC pass.

filter_non_bacillota.description: Exclude samples whose GTDB-Tk phylum is not Bacillota/Firmicutes instead of warning only.

me_flank_bp.description: Flanking nucleotides to extend upstream and downstream when slicing detected ICE/IME intervals.

cargo_scope.description: Scope of AMR/CARD, eggNOG, and DefenseFinder cargo profiling: extracted mobile elements only ('elements') or whole genome ('genome').

amr_derep_overlap.description: Minimum reciprocal coordinate overlap fraction (0-1) to merge AMRFinderPlus and CARD RGI hits.

rgi_include_loose.description: Include CARD RGI 'Loose' hits in addition to 'Perfect' and 'Strict' during AMR/CARD dereplication.

eggnog_tax_scope.description: Taxonomic scope passed to eggNOG-mapper (--tax_scope), e.g. '1239' (Bacillota/Firmicutes) or '2' (Bacteria).

att_flank_bp.description: Flanking window length (bp) around boundary integrases searched for attL/attR direct repeats.

me_ani_threshold.description: Minimum skani nucleotide ANI percentage to group two ICEs/IMEs into the same cohort cluster.

me_af_threshold.description: Minimum skani aligned fraction percentage to group two ICEs/IMEs into the same cohort cluster.

synteny_max_elements_per_cluster.description: Maximum number of representative ICE/IME slices plotted per cluster in pyGenomeViz synteny figures.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix added to Nextflow execution report filenames.
